title: VCMI saved game or map metadata
description: Information on a saved game or a map that can be read without loading mods used by it. Also read from saves of newer versions, which may add new fields

text.description: Text that can be displayed without texts of the map or campaign

translations.description: Text in every language provided by the map or campaign, language -> text

vcmiVersion.description: Version of VCMI that created the save, only for display to the player. Present only for saved games, missing for saves in legacy format

saveTime.description: Time when the save was created, in seconds since Unix epoch. Present only for saved games, missing for saves in legacy format

creationDateTime.description: Time when the map was created, in seconds since Unix epoch, 0 or missing if unknown

format.description: Format of the original map, value of EMapFormat

difficulty.description: Difficulty of the map as defined by its author

players.description: Number of players on the map

humanPlayers.description: Number of players on the map that can be controlled by a human

game.description: State of the game, present only for saved games

campaignScenario.description: Index of the current scenario in the campaign, only for campaigns

mapFile.description: Name of the map file, or of the campaign file for campaigns, empty for random maps

humanPlayers.description: Number of players controlled by a human in this game

saveDirectory.description: Directory with autosaves of this game

day.description: Total number of days passed in the game, missing for saves in legacy format

mods.description: Mods that affect gameplay: active mods for saved games, mods required by the map for maps. Root mod identifier -> mod

submods.description: Active submods that affect gameplay, as identifiers relative to the root mod
